card.name: Punctuation before page numbers in citations
card.fires_on: Spaces, colons and parentheses right before volume, issue or page numbers in journal and statute citations, mostly from the early-to-mid 20th century.

modes.label: Before page range
modes.description: A space or colon after a journal name or volume, just before page numbers.

modes.label: Journal abbreviation
modes.description: Inside or after an abbreviated journal title in a reference list.

modes.label: Statute citation
modes.description: A space before a page or law number in a legal act citation.

card.writes: It nudges output toward wartime and mid-century history terms and away from computer terms, which suggests a sense of older dated references.
card.plain: It fires on the small gap or colon just before page numbers in old journal and law citations.
